More than boxing

Performance begins with self-awareness.

Boxing provides the environment. The real work is learning to recognise pressure, understand responses, make deliberate choices and carry those skills into everyday life.

Physical capability

Movement, coordination, conditioning and boxing-based skill development, adapted to the individual.

Emotional regulation

Breathing, attention, reflection and tools to respond rather than react under pressure.

Self-governance

Responsibility, decision-making and leadership built through consistent practice and reflection.

Our development framework

Recognise. Understand. Choose. Act.

The SCC learning process moves from awareness to deliberate action and adaptation.

RECOGNISEUNDERSTANDCHOOSEACTOBSERVEADAPTSELF-GOVERN

Individual-first coaching

Our approach begins with one-to-one sessions. Where appropriate, athletes can later train in carefully matched pairs. Training is tailored to developmental stage, confidence and individual needs.

Reflective practice

Physical training is supported by conversation, journaling and practical strategies drawn from Stoic philosophy, Māori frameworks and restorative practice.

Programmes are designed for young people aged 4–18. Participation and activities are assessed for individual suitability. A first introductory session is offered free to explore fit.

Meet the founder

Lewis Aperahama

Human Performance Coach · Youth Development Practitioner

Lewis Aperahama founded Stoic Code Combat to bring together boxing, leadership development, Stoic philosophy and Māori approaches to personal growth.

His background spans coaching, youth work, outdoor and diving environments, and community leadership. His work focuses on helping young people develop the skills to understand themselves, manage pressure and take responsibility for their decisions.

Based in Hawke's Bay, Lewis is also undertaking postgraduate study in human performance leadership.

Stoic Code Combat is a youth human performance programme, not a childcare service or a promise of competitive boxing outcomes.
